purpose: Version selected durable Brain state in a local Git repository without requiring any specific remote hosting provider.
rules: The local user-owned workspace remains authoritative even when Git is unavailable.
Initialization must not create, choose, or push to a remote automatically.
Initialization performed by the transport must use an explicit empty Git template so configured template hooks are not copied into the new repository.
Transport-created commits must disable Git hooks for that commit rather than executing repository or configured hooks implicitly.
Transport must refuse active Git filter attributes on durable snapshot inputs before inspecting or staging their contents.
Transport must refuse a detached HEAD after the repository has commits; snapshots belong on a named branch.
Transport-controlled Git invocations disable automatic CRLF conversion.
Transport Git subprocesses must have finite timeouts.
Snapshots may stage only paths explicitly listed as durable paths.
Refuse a snapshot when unrelated or excluded paths are already staged.
Third-party source trees and quarantine contents are reproducible inputs and are not part of the durable Brain snapshot.
A Git failure must not corrupt or delete local workspace state.
